text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq dismisses Kuwaiti statement that it had bombed Kuwaiti oilfields during the Gulf War in 1991.
- Iraq urges the U.N. chief and the Security Council to investigate the recent Turkish violations of Iraq's territory in northen Iraq.
- A French parliamentary delegation which visited Iraq recently said in Paris that it would work for ending French participation in policing no-fly zones in Iraq.
